en.t: The year-end passed in a rush.

units.source_text: 是年春，今上朱雀帝患病。

en.t: That spring, the reigning Emperor Suzaku fell ill.

units.source_text: 传位之事，引起世间种种议论。

en.t: The matter of transferring the throne stirred up all kinds of public discussion.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝的后宫，即右大臣的女儿承香殿女御，曾经生下一位皇子。

en.t: Among Emperor Suzaku's consorts, the Kokiden consort, daughter of the Minister of the Right, had once given birth to a prince.

units.source_text: 但年仅二岁，未免太幼稚了。

en.t: But he was only two years old, far too young.

units.source_text: 因此皇位应该传给藤壶皇后所生皇太子。

en.t: Therefore the throne ought to pass to the crown prince born to Empress Fujitsubo.

units.source_text: 选定新帝的辅相者时，朱雀帝屈指计算，认为只有源氏公子最为适当。

en.t: When choosing someone to assist the new emperor, Emperor Suzaku counted through the possibilities and judged that only Prince Genji was truly suitable.

units.source_text: 但此人现正流放在外，实甚可惜，乃是朝廷一大损失。

en.t: But this man was now living in exile, which was deeply regrettable and a great loss to the court.

units.source_text: 因此他就顾不得弘徽殿太后的反对，决定赦免源氏之罪。

en.t: Therefore, disregarding the objections of the Kokiden Empress Dowager, he decided to pardon Genji's offense.
